title: Car minimum acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the sedan's minimum acceleration to pass the crosswalk before the pedestrian reaches B, obtaining 8/3 m/s².

title: Truck minimum acceleration
description: Important: Applies the correct condition for the truck to completely pass the crosswalk before the pedestrian reaches B, finding the required acceleration.

title: Cargo-truck relative motion
description: Important: Analyzes the relative motion between the cargo and truck during acceleration, setting up equations for their displacements.

title: Minimum d2 calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the minimum distance d2 from the cargo to the rear of the truck to avoid collision, obtaining 20/9 m.

title: Pedestrian crossing times
description: Important: Correctly identifies and uses the pedestrian's travel times to points B and across the full crosswalk.

title: Truck deceleration range lower bound
description: Essential: Determines the minimum deceleration for the truck to stop exactly at the stop line before the pedestrian finishes crossing.

title: Cargo displacement constraint
description: Important: Applies the condition that the cargo's stopping distance relative to the truck's front must not exceed d1 for the maximum deceleration.

title: Truck deceleration range upper bound
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum deceleration such that the cargo does not collide with the truck's front, obtaining 5 m/s².

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration/deceleration in kinematic equations, leading to wrong direction of motion.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to maintain consistent units (meters, seconds) throughout calculations, leading to numerical errors.
